items.summary_en: Mid-October through mid-December is deer mating season, which can be a danger to drivers as the sex-seeking creatures cross roadways throughout the Garden State.
items.summary_zh: 十月中旬到十二月中旬是鹿的交配季节，这对司机来说可能是一个危险，因为这些寻求性的动物穿过整个花园州的道路。

items.title_en: Archaeologists In Turkey Believe They Just Found The World’s Oldest Shipwreck
items.title_zh: 土耳其考古学家相信他们刚刚发现了世界上最古老的沉船
items.summary_en: Hakan Öniz Researchers off the coast of Kekova Island in Antalya discovered artifacts from a shipwreck that dates back as far as 4,700 years. An ancient cargo vessel believed to be the world’s oldest shipwreck has been found off the coast of Turkey. This sunken ship dates back an astonishing 4,700 years — right around the time when the pyramids of Egypt were being built just across the Mediterranean Sea.
